_comment: Projects that need a specific JDK version that cannot be auto-detected from pom.xml. Key is the repo name (as used in chunk files), value is the JDK version (8, 11, 17, 21, 25). Typical reasons: source level 5/6 (need JDK 8), Nashorn/JavaScript (need JDK 11), reflection access (need JDK 8/11).
